client.name: <Client legal / brand name>
client.domain: <example.com : null if no live site yet>
client.buying_intent: <the core commercial action a buyer takes, e.g. 'buy a food-photoshoot service'>
client.stated_goal: <the client's own goal, verbatim if given>
do_not_call: <terms the client refuses to be branded with>
client._comment: Only name is truly needed. Fill what you know; leave the rest null : every field degrades gracefully.

entity._comment: The EAV brief. Enough to build Report 3 + the topical map even with ZERO input files.
entity.bridge: <the L2 bridge, e.g. 'Food Photography by AI'>
convincing_dimensions: <why choose the bridge, e.g. low cost>
entity.funnel: <one-line funnel thesis: target broad Dimension+entity demand, then introduce the bridge + convincing dimensions>
entity.conclusion: <the position to land, e.g. 'AI for Food Photography'>

inputs._comment: EVERY input is optional. null = not provided → its report(s) drop or lighten, never block. Extra/bespoke files: list them under 'custom' and fold each into the closest report or an appendix.

apis._comment: Toggle the data sources this run may use. Each is a pre-configured MCP server; false or unavailable → that source degrades gracefully. No secrets here.

baseline._comment: Optional overrides for the initial Baseline Snapshot (Report 10, scripts/baseline_metrics.py). Every field degrades gracefully -- leave null to use the documented default. gsc_*_window_months only matter if apis.google_search_console is true; gbp_search only matters if the client is a local/location business worth matching to a GBP listing.

gbp_search._comment: Inputs for business_data_business_listings_search. null business_name falls back to client.name; a low-confidence/no match is reported as such, never silently accepted as the client's listing.
